text:
tess - AE: Quick: customer ZenithHealth wants a 7-day Private POC (onprem inference + AWS). They want low latency and client IPs in logs. What pattern do we recommend and a small pasteable firewall snippet?

omar - solutions eng: PrivateLink per-VPC is fastest to stand up and minimizes routing changes. For src-ip preservation you must avoid SNAT en route to the ENI (or use 1:1 NAT). TGW can preserve src-ip too but needs routing handoff. For a 1TB 7-day POC ballpark network add-on: ~ $12-$20 (endpoints + data).

kai - netops: Firewall snippet (replace CIDRs with our ENI list):
- proto: tcp
  ports: [443]
  dest_cidr: ["10.60.70.0/28"]
  description: "Allow Redwood Private ENIs"
# To preserve client IP: ensure no SNAT between app subnets and the ENI route or use 1:1 NAT.

rachel - security: TLS inspect caveat: if they terminate TLS for DLP, mutual-TLS and client certs break. Recommend a passthrough/bypass for our ENI CIDRs and include SAML/SCIM integration details in the questionnaire response.

ticket-bot: Created support ticket ZH-POC-009 and linked docs: https://support.redwood.ai/ZH-POC-009

tess - AE: Thanks all
